item.title: Reading Log
item.description:
This is a running list of things I am reading this month and a one-line takeaway for each.

  1. A short essay on attention: clarity beats volume.
  2. A technical blog post on caching: measure before you optimize.
  3. A chapter on habits: make the good path the easy path.
